entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry for callin' so late—I wanted to[n]ask you about that summer festival.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You remember, the one I told you[n]about?
I forgot.
I think so...
Let me sleep.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aw, c'mon! The whole thing with[n]the kebabs.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well I KNOW so, dammit! C'mon,[n]the whole thing with the kebabs?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aw, c'mon—we're all tired from the[n]tests an' shit, but just gimme a sec!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I completely spaced on it until now,[n]but the festival's tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, you wanna go?
Fine, fine.
I have a lot of homework...
I'll think about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeah! I knew you'd be down!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, it's just one day! Just do it later!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's go!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's tomorrow—there ain't time for that![n]Let's just go!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's make sure we invite Yusuke too.[n]He's always down to chow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I diiiid just remember they said it[n]might rain tomorrow, though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, whatever! No way's it gonna rain[n]on a day like this. See ya tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How would HE know whether or not[n]it'll rain?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sheesh, all worked up over a silly little[n]festival... full of food... of all kinds...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, I suppose you deserve to enjoy[n]yourself, but be sure to keep a low[n]profile, all right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, let's get some sleep.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh—and, uh, no sleeping in, got it?[n]I'm gonna skip breakfast for this.
